meta.notes: Five-band graphic EQ, Bluetooth-only. Frequencies and Q values taken from acoustic measurements by EQ Practice, which reports the bands behave like PK filters with Q≈0.7 (100 Hz, 315 Hz, 1 kHz, 3.2 kHz) and Q≈0.6 (10 kHz). Bluetooth namePrefix is a placeholder until a real capture confirms the advertised name. No protocol block: the device bridge has no handler for HiBy W3 II yet. Preamp is auto; the source notes the device's own preamp calculation underestimates the cumulative boost, which is a realization quirk (D39) and is deliberately not modelled here.
